tiers.name: Per-Tensor `cudaIpcOpenMemHandle` & `cudaIpcCloseMemHandle` Every Step (`512` Calls/Step)
tiers.note: Calling cudaIpcOpenMemHandle + Close 512 times/step triggers GPU MMU page-table mapping & implicit device syncs (18.40ms stall)!

tiers.name: Per-Tensor `POSIX FD` IPC Without Base-Segment Deduplication (`EMFILE: Too Many Open Files`)
tiers.note: Exporting a new SCM_RIGHTS POSIX FD per tensor sub-slice quickly exceeds Linux default ulimit -n 1024 -> fatal EMFILE crash!

tiers.name: Cached Legacy `cudaIpcGetMemHandle` on Base `cudaMalloc` Segments (`BasePtr + ByteOffset`)
tiers.note: Maps each 2GB CUDACachingAllocator base segment once and passes byte offsets (0.015ms), but fails with CUDA_ERROR_NOT_SUPPORTED when expandable_segments:True or GB200 MNNVL is used!

tiers.name: CUDA VMM `cuMemExportToShareableHandle` (`POSIX FD` / `FABRIC`) Base-Pool Registry + Offset Arithmetic
tiers.note: Maps physical VMM slabs once at init (closing temp FDs immediately after cuMemMap!) and exchanges pure (slab_id, byte_offset) in 0.002ms (9,200x faster, VMM + GB200 MNNVL ready)!
